kind_note: Early Dynastic royal cemetery + EEF temenos/cemetery work

summary.zh: 早王朝王陵核心区（Umm el-Qaab）：Petrie《王陵》报告；另有 Petrie《阿拜多斯》I（1902）与 Randall-MacIver《El Amrah and Abydos》相关工作。Wilkinson 综述其在国家形成与王权丧葬建筑中的地位。
summary.en: Early Dynastic royal cemetery core (Umm el-Qaab): Petrie’s Royal Tombs; plus Petrie Abydos I (1902) and Randall-MacIver El Amrah and Abydos. Wilkinson synthesizes Abydos in state formation and royal mortuary architecture.
